The two functions are therefore distinct and the distractors exchange them: the classes do the choosing and the lot only orders the chosen, and the presence of a lot says nothing about how many the army will eventually want. questions.explanation: A national duty only becomes a national habit if ordinary people can discharge it, and a distribution network of banks, post offices and payroll deductions is what does that, because it meets the saver where he already deals rather than where he would have to go. questions.explanation: The leaflet performs two moves. It makes the target of domestic criticism the ally of a foreign enemy, and it then puts the reader in the position of someone whose own conduct is at issue, which is a way of narrowing what counts as an acceptable opinion rather than of informing anybody. Concealment of cost would be the opposite instinct, since a government that wanted to avoid the burden would not be the one naming it; printing an enemy's own words is an appeal to evidence, which is the very appeal this campaign refuses. Practice did not always stay inside that door, but the wording is what is being asked about here. So the limit lay upstream, in the plate that becomes a hull and in the machine tools that cut it, and that is the ordinary shape of a wartime production problem. The scarce thing is seldom the labour that assembles a product and nearly always the material and the machine capacity that turns raw stock into parts. Berths, welders and dredging are all genuine features of building ships, and none of them explains a yard with men standing idle, which is the observation the stem actually supplies.

questions.explanation: A ceiling fixes a price and does nothing about an available quantity, so when supply is short the shops empty anyway and the coupon is what decides whose turn it is to buy. The result is a want the lawful market cannot satisfy at the price the rules name, and the gap between what a buyer would give and what the rules allow is a price waiting to be paid somewhere it is not permitted. Coupons and ceilings are therefore complements rather than rivals: one apportions what exists, the other caps what may be charged, and neither conjures up another sack of anything. A lower price does not shorten a queue in front of an empty shelf, which is the trap in the first distractor.

answer.exemplar: It changed who counted as available labour: an employer who had for years screened out women and Black workers now had to hire them, and the federal rules on equal pay and on the conditions of work made the terms something other than the old private bargain, so the obstacle was a habit of exclusion rather than any difference in ability. It also moved rural families into cities at a scale no peacetime wage difference had achieved, because the pay was not only higher but continuous and came with housing and food that could be obtained.

questions.explanation: Two features carry the point. The breach came from a procedure that never varied, which is what made a steady flow of readable traffic available at all, and the use the report records is a change of course, a convoy sent somewhere else. A striking force that must close to a fixed range and has come a long way from its own shore is at its most exposed while it is closing, and a fleet that has been long enough at sea to want repair is a fleet with damaged machinery, fuelled holds and tired crews. questions.explanation: The mechanism is that the convoy is only as fast as its weakest member, and that is precisely what puts every ship inside the escort's reach and keeps the group in one body instead of strung out along the route. It is why the method is described as the abandonment of independent steering, and why a slow ship's inability to keep up has to be met by a sea rescue rather than by permission to run ahead. It does not shorten the voyage, since a group almost always loses days against a lone ship pushing flat out, and a convoy is more visible than one hull. Nor does it transfer command: the master keeps his duties, and radio silence matters rather than less when the target is a whole formation.

questions.explanation: The three things named work together and none of them is invulnerability. A sloping hull presents less of a target at any given angle and makes a hit likely to deflect, a low profile is both harder to see and harder to engage, and volume on the line means a defender who stops one has destroyed a small fraction of a force rather than a unique machine. What changed is a ratio: what a defender must spend for each round fired against what the attacker can afford to lose, and that is why a gun that could stop one vehicle could not stop many. questions.explanation: What the clause does is join liability to damage, and it is drafted as a provision other signatories can act upon. A fixed total would make the dispute arithmetic, and a strip of sovereignty or a criminal tribunal would make the treaty a different instrument entirely, neither of which the description mentions. questions.explanation: The change is in who could be dealt with. A council of appointed members answers to the government that appointed it and can be replaced at will, so a negotiation with it settles nothing about the population; an organisation that has enrolled people with no vote and no seat has made the government's own claim to speak for the colony contestable, and any arrangement now has to be one that such a body will accept. That is a structural change in the terms and not a grant of standing, and it does not mean negotiation becomes impossible, since the whole point of the change is that the alternative to dealing with a representative body is dealing with a population. Historians differ over how far the movement's pressure and the government's own reassessment each contributed, and the item turns on the change in counterpart rather than on that weighting.
